0.25.name: Flashforge Creator 5 Pro 0.25 nozzle
0.25.machine_start_gcode:
;start_gcode
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M106 P101 S0 ; L+R_PLA_Turbo_Fan_0-255
M106 P2 S0 ; Center_Fresch_Air_Input_Fan_for_PLA30%_(80_0-255) 
M106 S0 ; Model_Fan_(Heat_Break_Cooler_80-255)100%=255
M106 P3 S0 ; Filter_Unit_Fan_0-255(ABS=255)
G90
M83
G1 Z5 F2400
T[initial_extruder]
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T[initial_extruder]
G1 X256 Y0 Z0.2 F6000
G1 E5 F{filament_max_volumetric_speed[initial_no_support_extruder]/2.4053*60}
G1 X216 E10 F{filament_max_volumetric_speed[initial_no_support_extruder]/2.4053*60}
;start_gcode end
